skill.summary: AI 图片提示词优化、高保真参考图融合与 1:1 还原技能。当用户说“ao”、要求根据上传图片生成更精准提示词、 严格复刻模特/产品/场景、完全参考上传模特风格、指定产品位置与角度、生成电商主图/详情页/九宫格/四视图/模特图、 需要轻奢/法式/运动/极简/买手店风品牌语气、优化 Flux / Nonbana /...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Major update: Added comprehensive reference documents for all use cases, including prompt patterns, product types, scene design, spatial descriptions, and brand tone mapping.
- Completely reworked workflow, now enforcing role assignment for each input image and explicit extraction of locked visual attributes.
- Enhanced support for e-commerce formats: requirements for main image, detail page, 9-grid, 4-views, and model shots will always output as separate instructions.
- Strict rewrite of prompt writing—location, angle, and tasks must be quantifiable and executable, never vague.
- Added special handling rules for lingerie/underwear and brand tone (luxury, French, athletic, etc.), with dedicated references.
- All outputs structured and modular: always deliver Chinese prompt, English prompt, negative prompt, and a clear sectioned analysis. JSON output format also specified.
